Cc: security@finholdings.com

Subject: Tenant boundary verification for Dedicated environment

Hannah,

We are finalizing our procurement checklist and need written confirmation and artifacts that the tenant for FinHoldings hosted on Redwood Dedicated will be strictly scoped to the US-west region and will not be replicated outside that boundary (including backups/snapshots). Specifically we need: 1) a short playbook describing how you verify regional isolation for a tenant, 2) the locations of backups and any cross-region DR replicas, 3) the retention/auto-delete policy and time-to-wipe when a tenant is decommissioned, and 4) evidence (logs or a signed attestation) that you can provide for audit.

Can you provide a checklist and an ETA for producing the artifacts? We aim to close procurement this month.

Thanks,
Laura Smith
Head of Security Operations
FinHoldings

Laura — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the playbook and artifacts; outlined below are the immediate next steps and what we'll deliver: 

1) Isolation verification playbook (document) — includes verification checklist, who runs it, and sample logs.
2) Snapshot & backup topology map — which clusters/backups are retained and where.
3) Retention policy excerpt + retention timeline for tenant data and snapshots.
4) Wipe & forensic-ready timeline — steps for tenant decommission, timestamps for start/completion, and evidence produced.
5) Attestation letter for audit (signed by Redwood security) — we'll produce this after we run a dry-run for your tenant.

Requests from your side: a preferred date/time for a 30-min working session for scope confirmation; also confirm whether FinHoldings requires a fully forensic image (longer lead) or a standard tenant-wipe attestation.

ETA: we can deliver a first-pass playbook and the snapshot topology within 4 business days after the working session. The signed attestation will follow after the dry-run (typically +5 business days).

Looping in Ben (infra) and Aditya (acct) to provide the technical artefacts and to schedule the session.

Laura / Hannah — sharing technical details and the checklist artifacts we typically provide. Summary first, then attachments.

Summary (short):
- Primary data plane: tenant compute and object storage are pinned to the US-west region (us-west-2) by default for FinHoldings Dedicated clusters.
- Backups & snapshots: daily snapshots are stored in the same region by default. Cross-region DR replicas are NOT enabled for region-locked tenants unless explicitly contracted (we would document that as a separate DR addendum).
- Metadata & logs: operational logs that contain tenant identifiers are kept in the same region; centralized monitoring metadata used for platform health is scrubbed of tenant-sensitive identifiers before being routed to cross-region analytics clusters.
- KMS & keys: customer tenant is encrypted with CMKs where the HSM/KMS is region-scoped; keys are not exported across regions.
- Retention: default snapshot retention is 30 days; object store retention is configurable — FinHoldings default will be set to 90 days unless you require longer.
- Wipe process: tenant decommission does staged purge: 1) revoke access and freeze writes; 2) delete primary objects and metadata; 3) remove snapshots and trigger secure overwrite/garbage collection; 4) run verification job and produce wipe report. Typical completion for a standard tenant-wipe is 48–72 hours; forensic-image wipes (with chain-of-custody evidence) take longer (7–10 business days).

What I'm attaching (stubs):
- redwood_isolation-checklist_v1.pdf — our verification checklist with items we will evidence (includes example log snippets).
- snapshot_topology_map.csv — mapping of snapshot IDs to region/cluster and retention rule.

Notes & caveats:
- If you require legal assurance that no copies exist outside us-west (including backups retained by managed replication), we recommend the Dedicated Isolation Addendum; absent that addendum, we can provide operational attestations and dry-run evidence.
- For customers in regulated spaces we also provide KMS key escrow options and HSM attestation reports on request.

Happy to run through the checklist with your team. Proposed slot: Thu 9 Jul 09:30–10:00 PDT.

Ben Carter
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
